author: Animalogic
description:
The Barbary macaque is one of the most amazing monkeys in the world, and the last living monkey in Europe. Humans have enjoyed watching them for millennia, and have kept them as pets, often illegally. This led to a crash in the wild population that almost made them go extinct. The tide is finally turning, but are we saving these monkeys fast enough?
